control: hook expansion contradicts the CED (1.2.C.1 and 1.3.A.4: the instantaneous value is the limit as the interval approaches zero, obtained by differentiating). The entry is correct, so only the hook should be rejected.
title: From average to instantaneous values
body: As the time interval used to calculate the average value of a quantity approaches zero, the average value approaches the instantaneous value.

hooks.hook_text: Average becomes instantaneous when the interval grows

expands_to.means: as the time interval becomes larger, the average approaches the instantaneous value

hooks.when_to_use: when relating average and instantaneous quantities
hooks.caution: State the limit in CED terms when answering.
